meaning_en: Accept means to receive or agree to something. Except means leaving out or apart from.
sentence: I cannot accept the offer, except for the travel allowance.

meaning_en: Affect is a verb meaning to influence. Effect is a noun meaning a result.
sentence: The rain will affect the match, and its effect will be felt by all teams.

meaning_en: Principal means the head of a school, or main. Principle means a basic rule or belief.
sentence: The principal explained the school principle of honesty.

meaning_en: Complement means something that completes or goes well with. Compliment means praise.
sentence: Her praise was a compliment, and the red scarf was a perfect complement to her dress.

meaning_en: Stationary means not moving. Stationery means paper, pens and envelopes.
sentence: The bus stayed stationary while we bought stationery from the shop.

meaning_en: Desert is a dry sandy region, or to abandon. Dessert is the sweet dish at the end of a meal.
sentence: He will never desert his friends, and he always orders dessert after dinner.

meaning_en: Lose means to misplace or fail to win. Loose means not tight.
sentence: Don't lose your keys; the loose screw needs fixing.

meaning_en: Council is a group of people who govern. Counsel means advice, or a lawyer.
sentence: The city council gave us wise counsel on the issue.

meaning_en: Emigrate means to leave one's country. Immigrate means to enter and settle in another country.
sentence: Many families emigrate from India and immigrate to Canada.

meaning_en: Historic means important in history. Historical means relating to the past.
sentence: The historic treaty was signed in 1947; it is a historical document.

meaning_en: Ensure means to make certain. Insure means to protect with an insurance policy.
sentence: Please ensure the house is insured before you leave.

meaning_en: Personal means private or individual. Personnel means the staff of an organisation.
sentence: The personnel department will discuss your personal leave request.

meaning_en: Precede means to come before. Proceed means to continue or go forward.
sentence: The introduction will precede the main speech; then we will proceed to questions.

meaning_en: Quiet means silent or calm. Quite means fairly, or completely.
sentence: The room was quite quiet after the speech.

meaning_en: Elicit means to draw out a response. Illicit means illegal or forbidden.
sentence: His question elicited an honest answer; the illicit trade was stopped.

meaning_en: Farther refers to physical distance. Further refers to extra degree or amount.
sentence: The school is farther from home, so we will discuss this further.

meaning_en: Imply means to suggest indirectly. Infer means to conclude from evidence.
sentence: His tone implied doubt, so I inferred he disagreed.

meaning_en: Sensible means wise and practical. Sensitive means easily hurt or affected.
sentence: It is sensible to be sensitive to others' feelings.

meaning_en: Cite means to quote as evidence. Site means a location. Sight means the ability to see or a view.
sentence: Cite your source, visit the building site, and enjoy the sight.

meaning_en: Adapt means to adjust to new conditions. Adopt means to take up or legally take in as one's own.
sentence: Students must adapt to new methods, and the couple chose to adopt a child.

meaning_en: Continual means happening again and again with breaks. Continuous means happening without any break.
sentence: The continual complaints annoyed us, as the noise was continuous.

meaning_en: Eminent means famous and respected. Imminent means about to happen.
sentence: An eminent scientist warned that the storm was imminent.

meaning_en: Capital means the city of government, or money. Capitol means the building where a legislature meets.
sentence: The capital city's capitol building attracts many visitors.

meaning_en: Alternate means taking turns, every other. Alternative means another choice.
sentence: We have an alternative plan; we will work on alternate days.

meaning_en: Ascent means climbing up. Assent means agreement or consent.
sentence: The climbers' ascent was slow, and the committee gave its assent.
